evidence.quote: I'm calling from the technical support centre at Brightline Computer Services.
It has been infected with a very dangerous virus.
Please don't turn the computer off or tell anyone.
You can pay by debit card, just read me the long number on the front and the three digits on the back.
To renew the protection for five years it is 299 pounds.
The hackers can see everything you type, including your online banking
it's very important we fix this right now, today.
Please don't turn the computer off or tell anyone.
If you switch it off now, the virus will delete all your files.
Download the program called HelpDesk Connect and tell me the nine digit code it shows you.
just read me the long number on the front and the three digits on the back.

caller_type.rationale: Scripted but responsive tech support scam flow with natural progression; no clear signs of recording or synthetic voice.
